sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-.8B-OptiQ-4bit Mixed-precision quantized with OptiQ — sensitivity-driven quantization for Apple Silicon This is a mixed-precision quantized version of Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B in MLX format. Unlike uniform quantization (all layers at the same bit-width), OptiQ measures each layer's sensitivity and assigns optimal per-layer bit-widths, preserving model quality where it matters most.
